title: My Project
author: Ok_Truth_324
selftext: Ive been at this for a month now just trying to sort it out. thought id share it. the goal is to ship it to my site, eventually, maintaining this level of detail or more. i used a method similar to kv cache reducing on graphics to get me here. Im reading 60fps on integrated arc graphics on my work laptop so far. This vid was taken on my desktop (5070). will be shipped with 3 or 4 maps with different modes. hands are my enemy so i swapped to cats to be less conspicuous...
